summary.text: Neil Riser is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 20 (Caldwell, Catahoula, Franklin, La Salle and Ouachita parishes), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Neil Riser's occupation as Owner, Riser Funeral Home.
It lists education as Caldwell Parish High School, 1980; Business Management, Northeast Louisiana University, 1984.

The page lists committee assignments including Commerce, Natural Resources and Environment, the State Bond Commission and the House Select Committee on Homeland Security, and caucus affiliations including the Central Louisiana Delegation Caucus, the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
